summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 0.65. Account h.ozturk@aegean.edu shows a long-standing baseline from device dev-ho-mbp: daytime on-campus access (193.140.10.45, AS-AEGEAN-EDU, Manisa, mail/sis/lms, no MFA) and evening remote access via TTNET (198.51.100.40) with MFA approved through VPN appliance vpn-edge-02 (lms/vpn). On 2026-10-11 a previously unseen device, dev-lab-ce-07 (193.140.10.87, same AS-AEGEAN-EDU/Manisa), appears in the evening immediately after the user's normal VPN MFA login and repeatedly accesses lms/sis at exact ~24-minute intervals for over two hours with no MFA prompts. No mail events are available to check for rules/forwarding, and no overt malicious actions (password changes, external exfil, impossible travel) are observed — all activity is within Turkey, Manisa, on the trusted university AS. The new device plus clockwork automation is an unexplained anomaly, but it is not confirmed takeover (same trusted network/city, no confirmed malicious action), so it does not meet the contain threshold; it is not fully explained as benign either; escalation is not required because evidence is adequate but ambiguous rather than insufficient/exposure-based. Recommend moni
